entities.summary: Estadio Bicentenario Municipal de La Florida is a multi-purpose stadium, located in La Florida, in eastern Santiago (Chile). It is the home stadium of the Chilean football team Audax Italiano. The stadium was built in 1986 and rebuilt in 2008.
